neighbourhood.capNote.defaultMessage: Six neighbours at most, always named. Beyond that the map teaches nothing: the list takes over.
neighbourhood.capNote.description: Note under the list of neighbours, saying why the map stops at six.

neighbourhood.distance.description: Label before the distance control of the neighbourhood map.

neighbourhood.existingPage.description: Legend of a plain edge of the map, leading to a neighbour that has a note.

neighbourhood.hop.description: A distance of the neighbourhood map, in hops from the page.

neighbourhood.list.description: Heading of the textual list of the neighbours under the map.

neighbourhood.map.description: Heading of the unfolded map, before the title of the page at its centre.

neighbourhood.mapCaption.defaultMessage: The list below carries the same information as the map.
neighbourhood.mapCaption.description: Caption of the map, for assistive technologies.

neighbourhood.none.description: Shown when the page has no neighbour.

neighbourhood.noteless.description: Legend of a dotted edge of the map, leading to a word nobody defined.

neighbourhood.seeMentions.description: Link to the mentions panel after the notice that the page has no neighbour.

neighbourhood.textualEquivalent.description: After the heading of the list of neighbours, saying that it equals the map.

neighbourhood.total.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {# neighbour in total, more than the map shows} other {# neighbours in total, more than the map shows}}
neighbourhood.total.description: Sentence under the map when the model holds more neighbours than the map draws.
